thread:
Maya: Quick debrief from the presales call with AtlasBank — they want a short POC (3 weeks) proving EU-only residency. Requirements: BYOK in EU, pin tenant to eu-central-1, and no control-plane telemetry leaving EU. They also want a named subprocessor list and network path sketch.

Kevin: TL;DR: BYOK supported for Private. We can PIN region to eu-central-1. Control plane is normally global, but options: EU control-plane slice (enterprise Private) or connector modes: standard, signaling-only, or air-gapped. Signaling-only removes metrics/logs but still does handshake. Air-gapped requires offline license + SOW.

Rochelle: Pricing note: for a 3-week POC with 2 reserved A10-equivalent GPUs + connector ops + EU control-plane slice, expect ~3-5x per-token vs hosted. I'll prepare a short cost matrix with line items: reserved compute, connector SOW (hours), EU control-plane (pro-rata), and optional on-site support.

Oliver_ops: Routing modes we support: STRICT_PIN (reject outside), SOFT_AFFINITY (prefer, allow spill), GLOBAL_FAILOVER (failover). Example config we can lock into the POC:

```
routing_policy:
  mode: STRICT_PIN
  pinned_region: eu-central-1
  allow_failover: false
  kv_cache_scope: regional
```

Maya: They will not accept any control-plane telemetry in non-EU. Can we confirm subprocessors and whether the connector sends any metadata to non-EU endpoints?

Kevin: Uploaded EU-only subproc snapshot to the presales ticket (PR-9002). Short summary: connector maintainer (our Ops team), customer cloud infra (customer-controlled in EU), optional metrics exporter (third-party) disabled by default. No CDN/central logging touches in Private on-prem flow unless explicitly enabled.

sec_bot: Security checklist: we require proof of EU KMS key jurisdiction (KMS ARN located in EU), completed Vendor Security Questionnaire section 4 (Data Residency), and signed DPA with EU residency addendum prior to any PII processing. Questionnaire link: https://redwood.example.com/presales/questionnaire

legal: If AtlasBank insists on EU-only control plane, Legal needs updated DPA + routing annex. Please flag early so we can draft. Air-gapped customers require a bespoke SOW and license flow.

Maya: Action items:
- Kevin: paste the EU subprocessor export link and confirm if any optional agents are enabled by default
- Rochelle: pricing matrix + SOW sketch (include engineering day rates for air-gap)
- Maya: send questionnaire link to AtlasBank and request KMS ARN
- Legal: standby to draft DPA variant if they require EU control plane

Kevin: Presales ticket created: https://redwood.example.com/tickets/PR-9002. ETA for subproc doc update: EOD tomorrow.

Maya: Thanks everyone. I'll loop the customer back in once we have the subproc list and the pricing sketch. :thumbsup:
